Before you cut someone out, ask this one question first.

Kevin explains that most articles on toxic relationships jump straight to getting rid of the person. He says the first question is why that person is in your life at all.

He admits you may not like the answer, but he believes you can handle it. In his view, the people who push your buttons point back to you, not to them.

When did you last blame someone for a feeling that was really yours?

#ad #relationships #mindset #kevintrudeau

Deepak's own son made a film that made him look terrible.

Kevin tells the story of Deepak Chopra. A reporter asked how it felt to be shown that way by his own son. Deepak answered calmly that his son hadn't made a film about him. His son had made a film about himself.

Kevin's point is simple: what you see in other people is what you believe and see in yourself.

Think of someone who annoys you. What might they be showing you about you?

#ad #relationships #mindset #kevintrudeau

Would you let a stranger carry rotten garbage into your living room?

Kevin uses this picture to make a point about negativity. If someone knocked on your door with a bag of rats and a bag of garbage, you would say no and send them away.

He asks why we don't do the same thing energetically with the people and moods we let in.

What have you been letting in lately that you would never let through your front door?
